(A) [0.8021, 0.5258, 0.9221, 0.6458]
(B) [0.2847, 0.4143, 0.4047, 0.5343]
(C) [0.0092, 0.1303, 0.1292, 0.2503]
(D) No defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
